r.d:
PEAR_Exception PHP5 error handling mechanism
Consider using PEAR2_Exception from http://pear2.php.net if you are developing for PHP 5.3+
r.n: This packge was split out from the PEAR package. If you use PEAR_Exception in your package and use nothing from the PEAR package then it's better to depend on just PEAR_Exception.
